gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the details of a specific task by its ID so that I can review its status and any associated comments.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the task details, including the task ID, title, description, status, assignee, and any comments.

gold.user: As a team lead, I need to cancel a task that is no longer relevant to our project, so that it does not clutter our task list.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the request and return a success message indicating that the task has been successfully canceled, along with the updated status of the task.
